description: This file defines the interface for accessing and manipulating a database within a software project. It includes function declarations for initializing, starting, destroying, performing resets, getting and setting parameter values, deleting parameters, transaction management, dumping the database, and handling data model hashes. It also defines some constants, external variables, and includes necessary headers. The file is part of a larger codebase related to a USP (Universal Service Platform) database API.

methods.name: DATABASE_Init
methods.description: Initializes the database with a specified file.

methods.name: DATABASE_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and releases database resources.

methods.name: DATABASE_PerformFactoryReset_ControllerInitiated
methods.description: Performs a factory reset as initiated by the controller.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetParameterValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter from the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_SetParameterValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: DATABASE_DeleteParameter
methods.description: Deletes a parameter from the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the database for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: DATABASE_ReadDataModelInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Reads data model instance numbers, optionally removing unknown parameters.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetMigratedHash
methods.description: Returns a migrated hash value for a given hash.
